log.text: Gholdengo used Make It Rain → Venusaur
Gholdengo used Make It Rain → Krookodile

decisions.rationale: Sableye Fake Out (Pelipper) + Venusaur Sleep Powder (Swampert) neutralizes rain T1. Venusaur survives any single hit from -0 Swampert (Ice Punch 55-94%, Liquidation 35-60%). T2 pivot Sableye→Charizard; Drought overrides rain, Chlorophyll Venusaur outspeeds and OHKOs Swampert with Giga Drain. Krookodile back provides Intimidate, EQ for Archaludon/Gholdengo, and Rock Slide for Gyarados. Intended Mega: Charizard Y.
decisions.notebook: Opponent rain team: Pelipper (Damp Rock Drizzle), Swampert-Mega (Swift Swim), Archaludon (Electro Shot rain synergy), Gyarados (Intimidate, DD), Grimmsnarl (Prankster screens, Light Clay), Gholdengo (Good as Gold). Weather war: slower weather wins on T1 if both setters lead. Venusaur Giga Drain is guaranteed OHKO on Mega Swampert. Prankster Taunt fails on Grimmsnarl (Dark type). Gholdengo blocks Fake Out (Ghost) and powder moves (Good as Gold). Plan: use Sleep Powder + Fake Out to stall rain, then bring Charizard to reset weather and sweep with Venusaur.

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Swampert. Lead Pelipper+Swampert sets Damp Rock rain and immediate Swift Swim pressure while denying sun/Chlorophyll. Back Archaludon (Electro Shot under rain) + Gholdengo (GaG vs Sableye/status, walls Dark/Ghost, hits Grass/Flying) complete the rain hyper-offense endgame.
decisions.notebook: Matchup: Rain hard-wins weather vs Mega CharY + Chlorophyll Venu. Primary WCs: Mega Swampert + Arch Electro Shot under rain. Gyarados Intim+DD vs Hydreigon/Krook. Grimm screens/Fake Out vs Sableye/Unburden. Gholdengo GaG walls Dark/Ghost, hits Grass. Lead rain pair; keep Gholdengo for Sableye/Sinistcha. Damp Rock Pelipper mandatory vs their sun.

decisions.rationale: Fake Out Pelipper prevents both Hurricane OHKO and Tailwind. Venusaur outspeeds base Swampert and Giga Drain is a guaranteed OHKO (117-208%) before Ice Punch. Only counter is Swampert Protect, but that burns their tempo and leaves Pelipper flinched with no progress.
decisions.notebook: Opponent rain team: Pelipper (Damp Rock Drizzle), Swampert-Mega (Swift Swim), Archaludon (Electro Shot), Gyarados (Intimidate/DD), Grimmsnarl (Prankster screens/Light Clay), Gholdengo (Good as Gold). Hurricane in rain is 100% accurate and OHKOs Venusaur. Swampert-Mega Swift Swim in rain outspeeds Venusaur. Giga Drain is guaranteed OHKO on Swampert. Weather war: Charizard-Y Drought overwrites rain on switch-in; slower weather wins if both set same turn.

decisions.rationale: Rain up; Mega Swift Swim + Ice Punch pressures Venu hard before GigaDrain. Tailwind covers Sableye Prankster and sets speed control. Avoid EQ ally hit and free Grass SE. Wide Guard less needed T1 vs no spread.
decisions.notebook: Matchup: Rain hard-wins weather vs Mega CharY + Chlorophyll Venu. Primary WCs: Mega Swampert + Arch Electro Shot under rain. Lead rain pair; keep Gholdengo for Sableye/Sinistcha. Damp Rock Pelipper mandatory vs their sun. Sableye MentalHerb Prankster; Venu LO Chlorophyll Timid.

decisions.rationale: Swampert dead to Venu; rain intact. Gholdengo walls Sableye status (GaG), resists Grass, pressures both with MIR/ShadowBall/Tbolt. Arch better later vs Hydreigon/Char after chip. Keep Arch back for ElectroShot endgame.
decisions.notebook: Matchup: Rain hard-wins weather vs Mega CharY + Chlorophyll Venu. Primary WCs: Mega Swampert + Arch Electro Shot under rain. Lead rain pair; keep Gholdengo for Sableye/Sinistcha. Damp Rock Pelipper mandatory vs their sun. Sableye MentalHerb Prankster; Venu LO Chlorophyll Timid. G1: Swampert KO'd T1 by Venu GD after Ice Punch chip; bring Ghold vs Sableye/Venu.

decisions.rationale: Switching Venusaur to Charizard sets Drought (sun replaces rain, Hurricane accuracy drops to 50%). Sableye Prankster Taunt (+1) blocks Pelipper Tailwind. Charizard takes at most 105% combined from Hurricane+Make It Rain, likely survives. Venusaur preserved for Chlorophyll sweep next turn. Sableye lives with 24-65% HP.
decisions.notebook: Opponent rain team: Pelipper (Damp Rock/Drizzle), Swampert-Mega (Swift Swim, fainted G1), Gholdengo (Good as Gold/Sitrus), Archaludon (Life Orb/Stamina), Gyarados (Leftovers/Intimidate), Grimmsnarl (Light Clay/Prankster). Good as Gold blocks all status moves. Hurricane 100% accurate in rain, OHKO range on Venusaur. Giga Drain guaranteed OHKO on Swampert-Mega. Weather war: Charizard-Y Drought overwrites rain on switch-in. Venusaur Chlorophyll doubles speed in sun. Plan: set sun with Charizard switch, Taunt Pelipper to deny Tailwind, then sweep with Venusaur Chlorophyll + Charizard-Y Heat Wave.

decisions.rationale: Rain locks weather; TW doubles our Spe so Ghold outspeeds Venu max and most backs. MIR spreads chip both (Sableye neutral, Venu NVE but LO chip). Peli TW before most actions. Avoid free status into Peli; Ghold Good as Gold blocks Taunt/WoW. Arch later for Electro Shot.
decisions.notebook: Matchup: Rain hard-wins weather vs Mega CharY + Chlorophyll Venu. Primary WCs: Arch Electro Shot under rain + Ghold. Lead rain pair; Ghold for Sableye/Sinistcha. Damp Rock Peli mandatory vs sun. Sableye MentalHerb Prankster; Venu LO Chlorophyll Timid. G1 Swampert died T1 to Venu GD; pivot Ghold. Prefer TW turns to sweep with Ghold/Arch. Respect Sableye Prankster status and Krook EQ/Intim. Sinistcha Hospitality+RagePowder support.

decisions.rationale: Protect priority +4 shields Krookodile from both foes. Venusaur at 5% pivots to Charizard; Drought removes rain before attacks, turning Weather Ball into resisted Fire and Hurricane to 70% accuracy. Charizard comfortably tanks any combination (Hurricane 28-67% + Shadow Ball 27-62% max 130% only if both single-target and high-roll). Sun enables Chlorophyll Venusaur later and Charizard-Y Heat Wave sweep.
decisions.notebook: Opponent rain team: Pelipper (Damp Rock/Drizzle), Swampert-Mega (Swift Swim, fainted G1), Gholdengo (Good as Gold/Sitrus), Archaludon (Life Orb/Stamina), Gyarados (Leftovers/Intimidate), Grimmsnarl (Light Clay/Prankster). Good as Gold blocks all status moves. Weather war: Charizard-Y Drought overwrites rain on switch-in. Venusaur Chlorophyll doubles speed in sun. Plan: set sun with Charizard switch, then sweep with Venusaur Chlorophyll + Charizard-Y Heat Wave. Gholdengo -2 SpA currently.

selection: Wide Guard (your side, including ally Gholdengo)
decisions.rationale: Venu 4% dies to anything; Krook 30% sash broken. Wide Guard blocks EQ/Rock Slide. MIR under TW KOs both weakened foes through -2 Spa (spread Steel hits Krook neutral, Venu SE). Rain+TW favor cleanup; Arch in back.
decisions.notebook: Matchup: Rain hard-wins weather vs Mega CharY + Chlorophyll Venu. Primary WCs: Arch Electro Shot under rain + Ghold. Lead rain pair; Ghold for Sableye/Sinistcha. Damp Rock Peli mandatory vs sun. Sableye MentalHerb Prankster; Venu LO Chlorophyll Timid. Prefer TW turns to sweep with Ghold/Arch. Respect Sableye Prankster status and Krook EQ/Intim. Sinistcha Hospitality+RagePowder support. G1: Krook sash broken T2 MIR.

decisions.rationale: Pelipper Weather Ball OHKOs both active mons and moves first under Tailwind. Switching Krookodile to Sableye absorbs the hit if Pelipper targets that slot; Charizard Mega Evolves + Protect to block the guaranteed OHKO on itself. Drought activates after Mega Evolution, setting sun for next turn when Sableye can Fake Out (Prankster) and Charizard-Y Heat Wave sweeps. Gholdengo at -4 SpA is negligible. Venusaur at 5% is too fragile to switch in safely.
decisions.notebook: Opponent rain team: Pelipper (Damp Rock/Drizzle), Swampert-Mega (Swift Swim, fainted G1), Gholdengo (Good as Gold/Sitrus, -4 SpA), Archaludon (Life Orb/Stamina), Gyarados (Leftovers/Intimidate), Grimmsnarl (Light Clay/Prankster). Good as Gold blocks all status moves. Plan: set sun with Charizard-Y Drought, then sweep with Venusaur Chlorophyll + Charizard-Y Heat Wave. Opponent Tailwind expires after turn 5.

selection: Wide Guard (your side, including ally Gholdengo)
decisions.rationale: Pelipper 25% dies to RockSlide/EQ chip+HeatWave; WG blocks EQ/RS/HW spreads. Ghold -4Spa still Tbolts Char hard (2x Electric) under rain TW outspeed; KO Char or force. Krook 30% dies next to WB/Arch. Avoid MIR more Spa drop.
decisions.notebook: Matchup: Rain hard-wins weather vs Mega CharY + Chlorophyll Venu. Primary WCs: Arch Electro Shot under rain + Ghold. Lead rain pair; Ghold for Sableye/Sinistcha. Damp Rock Peli mandatory vs sun. Sableye MentalHerb Prankster; Venu LO Chlorophyll Timid. Prefer TW turns to sweep with Ghold/Arch. Respect Sableye Prankster status and Krook EQ/Intim. Sinistcha Hospitality+RagePowder support. G1: Krook sash broken T2 MIR. CharY not mega yet T4.

decisions.rationale: Solar Beam guarantees Pelipper KO regardless of Wide Guard. Foul Play is single-target, bypasses WG, SE on Gholdengo. Gholdengo at -4 SpA does negligible damage. Tailwind expires after this turn, giving Charizard speed control. Both foes are faster now, so Wide Guard can't be stopped, but single-target moves ignore it. After Pelipper falls, Charizard + Sableye cleanly handle Gholdengo + backline.
decisions.notebook: G1: Opponent rain team (Pelipper Damp Rock/Drizzle, Swampert-Mega Swift Swim fainted, Gholdengo Good as Gold/Sitrus, Archaludon Life Orb/Stamina, Gyarados Leftovers/Intimidate, Grimmsnarl Light Clay/Prankster). Good as Gold blocks all Prankster status moves including Taunt and Will-O-Wisp. Pelipper carries Wide Guard. Gholdengo at -4 SpA -1 Atk is offensively neutered. Tailwind expires after turn 5. Sun mode (Charizard-Y + Venusaur Chlorophyll) beats rain; preserve Charizard and eliminate Pelipper first to lock weather.

selection: Wide Guard (your side, including ally Gholdengo)
decisions.rationale: Ghold -4 SpA is near-useless and dies to any CharY Fire; Peli 25% dies to HW. WG (+3) blocks HW; Protect blocks WB/SolarBeam/FP. GaG blocks Sableye status on Ghold. Survive TW end; Arch next.
decisions.notebook: Matchup: Rain hard-wins weather vs Mega CharY + Chlorophyll Venu. Primary WCs: Arch Electro Shot under rain + Ghold. Lead rain pair; Ghold for Sableye/Sinistcha. Damp Rock Peli mandatory vs sun. Sableye MentalHerb Prankster; Venu LO Chlorophyll Timid. Prefer TW turns to sweep with Ghold/Arch. Respect Sableye Prankster status and Krook EQ/Intim. Sinistcha Hospitality+RagePowder support. G1: Krook sash broken; CharY Drought after mega. Ghold GaG blocks status.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Heat Wave under sun hits both super-effectively; Foul Play into Gholdengo guarantees it falls even on a low Heat Wave roll. Archaludon's only one-turn threat is Draco Meteor (74–107%), which may take Charizard out, but removing Gholdengo and possibly Archaludon leaves 3v1 at worst. Electro Shot needs a charge turn in sun so Archaludon cannot OHKO Charizard this turn with it. Aggressive line maximizes KO odds and closes the game fastest.
decisions.notebook: G1: Opponent rain team (Pelipper Damp Rock/Drizzle, Swampert-Mega Swift Swim fainted, Gholdengo Good as Gold/Sitrus, Archaludon Life Orb/Stamina, Gyarados Leftovers/Intimidate, Grimmsnarl Light Clay/Prankster). Good as Gold blocks all Prankster status moves including Taunt and Will-O-Wisp. Electro Shot is two-turn outside rain; sun prevents instant fire. Pelipper carries Wide Guard. Gholdengo at -4 SpA -1 Atk is offensively neutered. Tailwind expired after turn 5. Sun mode (Charizard-Y + Venusaur Chlorophyll) beats rain; preserve Charizard and eliminate Pelipper first to lock weather.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Ghold -4 Spa nearly useless; Protect dodges CharY Fire spread and Sableye Foul Play while Arch LO Electro Shot KOs/chips CharY under sun (charge+fire in sun). GaG blocks status on Ghold. Next turn Ghold free.
decisions.notebook: Matchup: Rain hard-wins weather vs Mega CharY + Chlorophyll Venu. Primary WCs: Arch Electro Shot under rain + Ghold. Lead rain pair; Ghold for Sableye/Sinistcha. Damp Rock Peli mandatory vs sun. Sableye MentalHerb Prankster; Venu LO Chlorophyll Timid. Prefer TW turns to sweep with Ghold/Arch. Respect Sableye Prankster status and Krook EQ/Intim. Sinistcha Hospitality+RagePowder support. G1: Krook sash broken; CharY Drought after mega. Ghold GaG blocks status. CharY Timid sun sweeper.

decisions.rationale: Charizard outspeeds both foes and Heat Wave guarantees Archaludon KO (8%) unless it Protects. Foul Play Gholdengo adds 38-89% on top of Heat Wave's 92-167%, virtually ensuring Gholdengo KO or forcing it to low HP. If Archaludon Protects, its Electro Shot charge is wasted and it's alone at 8% next turn. Gholdengo at -4 SpA and streak-2 Protect is minimally threatening. This maximizes pressure on both slots.
decisions.notebook: G1: Opponent rain team defeated. Pelipper Damp Rock/Drizzle fainted, Swampert-Mega Swift Swim fainted. Remaining threats: Archaludon Life Orb/Stamina (Electro Shot two-turn outside rain, Flash Cannon, Draco Meteor, Protect), Gholdengo Good as Gold/Sitrus (Make It Rain, Shadow Ball, Thunderbolt). Good as Gold blocks all Prankster status. Sun mode (Charizard-Y + Venusaur Chlorophyll) wins weather war. Preserve Charizard, eliminate Pelipper first to lock weather. Gholdengo Protect streaks tracked; at -4 SpA it's offensively neutered.

decisions.rationale: Arch 9% dies to any hit; Electro Shot sun-charges so free chip only if survives. Ghold -4 SpA needs SE Thunderbolt to pressure 85% CharY (outruns Sableye). Protect fails after streak2. Shadow Sableye weak vs Prankster support. MIR resists on Char. Pivot to KO Char before sun ends.

reflections.summary: We won because we eliminated Pelipper early, locking sun with Charizard-Y and neutralizing the rain mode. Charizard's Heat Wave then cleaned up the weakened Archaludon and Gholdengo, the latter crippled by its own SpA drops and consecutive Protects.
reflections.adjustment: Next game, expect the opponent to protect Pelipper better, possibly leading Grimmsnarl for screens/Fake Out or Gyarados for Intimidate. Consider bringing a non-Prankster Taunt user or a screen breaker to disrupt their support, and be ready to pivot if they lead differently to preserve weather.
reflections.notebook: G1: Opponent rain team (Pelipper Damp Rock/Drizzle, Swampert-Mega Swift Swim, Archaludon Life Orb/Stamina, Gholdengo Good as Gold/Sitrus) defeated. Unrevealed: Gyarados (Intimidate, Leftovers, Dragon Dance) and Grimmsnarl (Prankster, Light Clay, screens, Fake Out, Spirit Break). Tendencies: Pelipper sets Tailwind early, uses Wide Guard to block spread moves. Gholdengo uses Protect consecutively (streak tracked). Archaludon's Electro Shot charges and boosts SpA even outside rain, threatening next turn. Good as Gold blocks all Prankster status. Sun mode (Charizard-Y + Venusaur Chlorophyll) wins weather war; preserve Charizard, eliminate weather setter first. Sableye should use Fake Out/Foul Play vs Gholdengo, not status. Next game, anticipate Grimmsnarl or Gyarados; prepare for screens and Intimidate.

reflections.summary: Lost because team-preview rain plan (Peli+Swampertite) failed to hold weather: CharY Mega Drought overrode, sun-boosted Solar Beam/Heat Wave cleaned Arch+Ghold after Peli dropped; Swift Swim mega never impacted.
reflections.adjustment: Question the bring—rain mega+Arch/Ghold suits poorly once sun flips; next game deny CharY mega/sun earlier or lead to force Krook/Sableye instead of Wide Guard stall under contested weather.
reflections.notebook: Matchup: Rain does not hard-win vs Mega CharY+Chlorophyll Venu (Drought overrides). Opp G1 brought CharY/Venu/Krook/Sableye (held Sinistcha/Hydreigon). CharY Timid Drought sweeper (Heat Wave/Solar Beam/Protect/Weather Ball). Sableye MentalHerb Prankster (Fake Out/WillOWisp/Taunt/Foul Play). Venu LO Chlorophyll Timid (Sludge Bomb). Krook FocusSash Intimidate Jolly (EQ/KnockOff/RockSlide/Protect). Ghold GaG blocks status. Damp Rock Peli still mandatory but insufficient alone. Prefer remove CharY pre-mega; respect Prankster+Intim. Sinistcha Hospitality+RagePowder still out.
